blocks.text: Python支持所有基本算术运算符，可以进行加减乘除等数学运算。

blocks.code:
# 算术运算符
a = 10
b = 3

print(f'a + b = {a + b}')   # 加法
print(f'a - b = {a - b}')   # 减法
print(f'a * b = {a * b}')   # 乘法
print(f'a / b = {a / b}')   # 除法
print(f'a // b = {a // b}') # 整除
print(f'a % b = {a % b}')   # 取余
print(f'a ** b = {a ** b}') # 幂运算

blocks.question: 10 // 3 的结果是什么？
blocks.explain: // 是整除运算符，结果为整数3

blocks.title: 练习：计算圆的面积
blocks.code:
import math

radius = 5
area = math.pi * radius ** 2
print(f'半径为{radius}的圆面积是: {area:.2f}')
blocks.hint: 使用 ** 运算符计算平方

blocks.text: / 返回浮点数，// 返回整数，% 返回余数

title: 比较与逻辑运算符
subtitle: 学习比较运算和逻辑运算

blocks.text: 比较运算符用于比较两个值，返回布尔值True或False。

blocks.code:
# 比较运算符
x = 10
y = 20

print(f'x == y: {x == y}')  # 等于
print(f'x != y: {x != y}')  # 不等于
print(f'x > y: {x > y}')    # 大于
print(f'x < y: {x < y}')    # 小于
print(f'x >= 10: {x >= 10}') # 大于等于
print(f'x <= 5: {x <= 5}')   # 小于等于

blocks.text:
x == y: False
x != y: True
x > y: False
x < y: True
x >= 10: True
x <= 5: False
逻辑运算符用于组合多个条件。

blocks.code:
# 逻辑运算符
age = 25
income = 8000

# and: 两者都为True
print(f'age>18 and income>5000: {age>18 and income>5000}')

# or: 至少一个为True
print(f'age<18 or income>10000: {age<18 or income>10000}')

# not: 取反
print(f'not (age>30): {not (age>30)}')

blocks.text:
age>18 and income>5000: True
age<18 or income>10000: False
not (age>30): True

blocks.question: True and False 的结果是什么？
blocks.explain: and运算符要求两边都为True才返回True

blocks.title: 练习：判断闰年
blocks.code:
year = 2024

is_leap = (year % 4 == 0 and year % 100 != 0) or (year % 400 == 0)
print(f'{year}年是闰年吗? {is_leap}')
blocks.hint: 闰年规则: 能被4整除但不能被100整除，或能被400整除

blocks.text: 比较运算符返回布尔值，可以用于if条件判断
